task.title: android-collection-check probe still taps the hidden ± stepper buttons
task.description: Two Android probes have rotted (both found during 2026-08-20 on-device verifications; product behavior is correct in both cases): (1) android-collection-check.mjs taps the ± stepper buttons, but below the sm breakpoint they are hidden (hidden sm:inline-flex) — the shipped affordance is tap-the-number-to-edit (count-stepper-value opens a native number input; verified working on the bench). (2) android-card-detail-check.mjs:57 uses an unqualified [data-testid=card-preview-sheet][role=dialog] locator and ?q=Lightning Bolt now returns 3 cards, so it dies on a strict-mode violation before its first assertion (not registered in package.json scripts either). Update both probes; keep routing authed surfaces through the /dev/components bench (dev proxy strips Cookie headers — specs/ui-work-loop.md 2026-07-19).
